Clean `lake build` FAILS under leanprover/lean4:v4.21.0 (and identically under leanprover/lean4:v4.14.0, ruling out a toolchain-pin artifact). 9 of 23 theorems do not compile: ordinary_routing_preserves_parent, ordinary_routing_preserves_defeat_witness, ordinary_routing_does_not_create_external_authorization, representation_only_does_not_create_external_authorization, ordinary_routing_from_initial_not_defeated, discovery_propagation_not_external_authorization, ordinary_router_has_no_defeat_constructor, ordinary_routing_preserves_well_formed, v82_refines_v81_nondefeat_routes. Root causes observed: (1) several 'cases o.kind <;> rfl' / 'simp [...]' proofs do not actually unfold applyObjection after casing on o.kind, because cases on a projection (o.kind) does not rewrite occurrences hidden inside the un-unfolded function application (applyObjection c o); (2) the simp call in v82_refines_v81_nondefeat_routes omits 'LegacyV81.route' from its simp set, so the legacy-routing definition is never unfolded; (3) discovery_propagation_not_external_authorization uses 'decide' on a goal containing free variables (c, o), which decide cannot close ('expected type must not contain free variables'). This was NOT fixed by this build pass per the task's instruction not to weaken or patch the proof unilaterally; it is reported as-is for the repository owner to address.

3 of the 8 theorems named in the supplement's 'Selected Lean theorem correspondence' table (ordinary_routing_preserves_parent, ordinary_routing_does_not_create_external_authorization, and the non-defeat refinement theorem v82_refines_v81_nondefeat_routes) are among the 9 theorems that fail to compile. The supplement's Build and release status section requires that the artifact not be called kernel-checked until a successful clean lake build is recorded; that condition is not currently met.
